lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਅਉਧਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa karat bihaanee audhahi gun nidh naam na gaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You have spent your life engaged in worldly pursuits; you have not sung the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਤ ਕਪਟੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaudee kaudee jorat kapate anik jugat kar dhaaio ||
lines.translation: Shell by shell, you accumulate money; in various ways, you work for this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bisarat prabh kete dukh ganeeahi mahaa mohanee khaaio ||1||
lines.translation: Forgetting God, you suffer awful pain beyond measure, and you are consumed by the Great Enticer, Maya. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਨਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahu anugrahu suaamee mere ganahu na mohi kamaaio ||
lines.translation: Show Mercy to me, O my Lord and Master, and do not hold me to account for my actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d daiaal kripaal sukh saagar naanak har saranaaio ||2||16||25||
lines.translation: O merciful and compassionate Lord God, ocean of peace, Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||16||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa raam raam rava(n)t ||
lines.translation: With your tongue, chant the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਆਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhod aan biuhaar mithiaa bhaj sadaa bhagava(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Renounce other false occupations, and vibrate forever on the Lord God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਈਤ ਆਗੈ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam ek adhaar bhagataa eet aagai tek ||
lines.translation: The One Name is the support of His devotees; in this world, and in the world hereafter, it is their anchor and support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kripaa gobi(n)d deeaa gur giaan budh bibek ||1||
lines.translation: In His mercy and kindness, the Guru has given me the divine wisdom of God, and a discriminating intellect. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran sa(n)mrath sreedhar saran taa kee gahee ||
lines.translation: The all-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is the Master of wealth - I seek His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਰਵਾਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: mukat jugat ravaal saadhoo naanak har nidh lahee ||2||17||26||
lines.translation: Liberation and worldly success come from the dust of the feet of the Holy Saints; Nanak has obtained the Lord's treasure. ||2||17||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 chaupade ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhaad sagal siaanapaa saadh saranee aau ||
lines.translation: Give up all your clever tricks, and seek the Sanctuary of the Holy Saint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham paramesaro prabhoo ke gun gaau ||1||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: re chit charan kamal araadh ||
lines.translation: O my consciousness, contemplate and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh kaliaan paavahi mitai sagal upaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You shall obtain total peace and salvation, and all troubles shall depart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa sut meet bhaaee tis binaa nahee koi ||
lines.translation: Mother, father, children, friends and siblings - without the Lord, none of them are real.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਰਬ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: eet oot jee naal sa(n)gee sarab raviaa soi ||2||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, He is the companion of the soul; He is pervading everywhere. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot jatan upaav mithiaa kachh na aavai kaam ||
lines.translation: Millions of plans, tricks, and efforts are of no use, and serve no purpose.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saran saadhoo niramalaa gat hoi prabh kai naam ||3||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure, and obtains salvation, through the Name of God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਊਚਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam daiaal prabhoo oochaa saran saadhoo jog ||
lines.translation: God is profound and merciful, lofty and exalted; He gives Sanctuary to the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: tis paraapat naanakaa jis likhiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||4||1||27||
lines.translation: He alone obtains the Lord, O Nanak, who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny to meet Him. ||4||1||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਮਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa gur sev sad hee ramahu gun gobi(n)d ||
lines.translation: Serve your Guru forever, and chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas araadh har har lahi jaai man kee chi(n)d ||1||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, worship the Lord, Har, Har, in adoration, and the anxiety of your mind will be dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jaap prabh kaa naau ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj ana(n)d paavahi milee niramal thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You shall be blessed with peace, poise and pleasure, and you shall find the immaculate place. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g udhaar ihu man aath pahar aaraadh ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, redeem your mind, and adore the Lord, twenty-four hours a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar binasai mitai sagal upaadh ||2||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger and egotism will be dispelled, and all troubles shall end. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: atal achhed abhed suaamee saran taa kee aau ||
lines.translation: The Lord Master is immovable, immortal and inscrutable; seek His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal araadh hiradai ek siu liv laau ||3||
lines.translation: Worship in adoration the lotus feet of the Lord in your heart, and center your consciousness lovingly on Him alone. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਨੑੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham prabh daiaa dhaaree bakhas leenhe aap ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God has shown mercy to me, and He Himself has forgiven me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sukh har naam deeaa naanak so prabh jaap ||4||2||28||
lines.translation: The Lord has given me His Name, the treasure of peace; O Nanak, meditate on that God. ||4||2||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਈ ਸੰਕਾ ਤੂਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaadee prabh dhiaaiaa gaee sa(n)kaa toot ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on God, and my doubts are gone.
